title.purpose: Borderless semibold task-title input; supporting titles retain their own utility sizes.

body.purpose: Task titles; fields share the font size without an authored line height.

label.purpose: Semibold field labels; regular-weight size also used for metadata and choices.

nav-mobile.purpose: Single-line compact destination captions; selected state is semibold.

description.purpose: Intentional 13px task-editor description, with 1.25rem leading. List descriptions remain 0.75rem.

shadows.name: floating-action-notice
shadows.purpose: Installed NativeWind large shadow for the floating add action and undo notice; native preset elevation is 8. Source values, not measured platform appearance.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Installed NativeWind extra-large shadow for composer, task details, search and shortcut help; native preset elevation is 13. Backdrop is black at 30% opacity.

motion.name: overlay-entry

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Tomato action with deep-tomato hover, 80% pressed opacity and 40% disabled opacity. Source minimum height is 2.75rem below md and 36px at md; these are CSS/source units.

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Fine-bordered warm secondary action with neutral hover fill and warm pressed fill; shares responsive source minimum heights and disabled opacity with primary.

components.name: Labelled field
components.description: Shared labelled field with neutral placeholder, tomato caret and global web focus outline. Task title, description and search inputs are separately borderless and suppress the outline.

components.name: Desktop destination
components.description: 36px-minimum desktop link on the 280-unit collapsible warm sidebar. Selected pale-tomato fill and tomato text/icon; inactive pressing uses selected fill. The shell changes at 850, separately from md controls.

components.name: Interval choice
components.description: Wrapping polyday link with a 3rem source minimum height. Selected pale-tomato fill, tomato border/text and semibold label; no separate hover fill is authored for this selector.

components.name: Settings panel
components.description: Flat, finely bordered settings container; this passive panel has no hover, focus or press state.

components.name: Task row
components.description: 54-unit-minimum flat task row. Separate 19-unit priority circle and title-to-details target; completion target is 3rem high and 2.75rem wide below md, 2rem above. Row tools appear on hover/focus within at md and remain visible below it; the schedule tool is desktop-only. More opens priority/delete actions. Completion and deletion offer 8-second undo notices.

components.name: Composer container
components.description: Compact, headerless composer, maximum width 550 source units and maximum height 90%, near the top (3.5rem; 7rem at md). Body scrolls with 16-unit padding and 10-unit gaps above a separated footer. Schedule/priority/recurrence open one panel at a time. Blank title disables add; new saves clear title/description, close the panel and refocus title. Inline entry shares this form. Static preview does not simulate submission or platform fade.

components.name: Browser device authorization
components.description: Browser approval for Mac sign-in using shared Field, Button and ErrorMessage. A growing ScrollView centres the fluid 410-source-unit panel with 24-unit outer padding, 2rem panel padding and 1.5rem gaps; short viewports scroll to both actions. Busy requests lock field/actions; empty codes disable actions. A persistent polite live Text receives the result and next step, replacing the form. Static preview uses synthetic data. Shared palette and responsive button styling apply; macOS widgets remain deferred.

components.html: Приоритет

narrative.northStar: Familiar Todoist task lists organised around personal wake intervals.
narrative.overview:
Polydays uses the user's pinned Todoist canon: compact task rows, warm white content, pale warm navigation, restrained tomato accents and system sans typography. Familiar navigation and separate completion circles keep repeated capture and completion direct.

The shared React Native and React Native for Web interface stays light, including in system dark mode. The macOS host bundles the shared RN Web client; macOS widgets remain deferred. Android widgets retain their separate native palette and dimensions. The direction contract is [Task lists](apps/client/.impeccable/surfaces/apps-client-src-app.md), with domain language in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md) and product authority in [docs/product.md](docs/product.md). Icons are Lucide vectors; no generated raster assets ship.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, priority-first task lists with separate completion and details targets.
Flat white surfaces, warm navigation and fine separators.
Tomato selection and action cues; P1–P4 remain distinct.
Collapsible desktop navigation and compact mobile destinations.
Repeated inline/modal capture with progressive schedule, priority and recurrence controls.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Use tomato for action, selection and overdue cues; keep ordinary content surfaces white or warm neutral.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep task titles visually primary and metadata subordinate; preserve the short mobile captions as text scales.

rules.name: The Flat Task Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep task rows and ordinary panels free of decorative lift; reserve the existing shadows for overlays, floating add actions and notices.

dos: Do preserve the pinned Todoist density, familiar destinations and separate completion circles.
Do keep P1–P4 visually distinct and task order priority-first.
Do let interval and metadata rows wrap, and retain compact mobile captions.
Do retain original polyday context for overdue work and widget freshness beside sync state.
Do keep the interface light when the system switches to dark mode.
Do retain progressive property disclosures, panel-first Escape and visible mobile row actions.
donts: Don't replace flat task lists with decorative cards, gradients or additional display typography.
Don't infer Android physical sizes from web CSS or shared utility names.
Don't invent motion curves or tonal ramps; use the documented source hover states.
Don't expose a direct polyday move for an existing deadline before explicit deadline removal.
Don't let shell or row shortcuts capture typing or inactive contexts; reserve Ctrl/Meta K for search.
Don't apply shared-client colors or CSS dimensions to native widget resources.
